turns.text: Lloyd, I'm stuck on this API integration. The auth token expires way too fast.
That's annoying. What's the current TTL set to? Maybe bump it up to 15 minutes for dev.
I'll try that. Also, did you see that new post from Itamar Friedman? He says vibe coding and loose rule adherence in AI tools contribute to real-world outages.
Yeah, I've seen that take floating around. He makes a good point about how 'good enough' code breaks in production.
Exactly. It feels like everyone is just prompting their way to deployment without understanding the stack.
True. Did you want to grab pizza later? I'm craving pepperoni.
Sure, but only if the API tests pass first. No pizza until green checkmarks.
Deal. I'll start the tests now.
Lloyd, this new update for the quick-research skill is confusing me.
What part is unclear? The output format or the trigger conditions?
I found out today that the quick-research skill writes a knowledge page if synthesis exceeds ~200 words or >=3 facts are found. Is that hard-coded?
Yes, those thresholds are currently fixed in the config file.
Got it. I'll adjust my query length to avoid unnecessary page creation.
Smart move. Did you order that mechanical keyboard switch set yet?
No, shipping is delayed. I think it's stuck in customs.
Ugh. Let me know if you need help tracking it.
